item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - The Strokes - Studio Albums (Qobuz FLAC)
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're all doing well.

I was wondering if anyone happens to have any of the following The Strokes albums from Qobuz, preferably in their original FLAC quality:

Is This It (2001)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/is-this-it-the-strokes/0078636810126

Room on Fire (2003)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/room-on-fire-the-strokes/0828765549721

First Impressions of Earth (2006)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/first-impressions-of-earth-the-strokes/0888880789709

Angles (2011)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/angles-the-strokes/0884977195552

Comedown Machine (2013)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/comedown-machine-the-strokes/soykj81vnhnfa

The New Abnormal (2020)
https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/the-new-abnormal-the-strokes/y8on5wkvkhpfc

If anyone happens to have any of these releases, even just one of them, and would be willing to share it, I would really appreciate it. There's absolutely no need for one person to have the entire collection — any album would be a great help.

Thank you very much in advance for your time and generosity. I truly appreciate any help!
